description: CodeCadenza supports building of Angular, JavaFX, Eclipse RCP, Eclipse RAP, Swing, JSF (Primefaces) and Vaadin applications. The generated applications can run in a stand-alone mode or they can be deployed on a Jakarta EE server (WilFly or Payara). Alternatively, the Spring platform is also supported! CodeCadenza applications use JPA in order to access the target database. The plug-in contains a graphical editor for designing the domain model.
